<div id="A1.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A1.p6.pic1" class="ltx_picture" height="926.41" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 477.38 926.41" width="477.38"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,926.41) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#B3B336;" fill="#B3B336" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 15.81 L 0 910.61 C 0 919.34 7.08 926.41 15.81 926.41 L 461.57 926.41 C 470.3 926.41 477.38 919.34 477.38 910.61 L 477.38 15.81 C 477.38 7.08 470.3 0 461.57 0 L 15.81 0 C 7.08 0 0 7.08 0 15.81 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#FFFFE6;" fill="#FFFFE6" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 1.97 15.81 L 1.97 899.4 L 475.41 899.4 L 475.41 15.81 C 475.41 8.16 469.21 1.97 461.57 1.97 L 15.81 1.97 C 8.16 1.97 1.97 8.16 1.97 15.81 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#FFFF99;" fill="#FFFF99" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 1.97 901.37 L 1.97 910.61 C 1.97 918.25 8.16 924.45 15.81 924.45 L 461.57 924.45 C 469.21 924.45 475.41 918.25 475.41 910.61 L 475.41 901.37 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 21.65 908.76)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:31.37em;--ltx-fo-height:0.85em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.25em;font-size:10pt;" height="15.21" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 11.75)" width="434.07"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:31.37em;">
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Identifying Preservation Set (<math id="A1.p6.pic1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="F^{sl}_{sel}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">F</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">e</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">l</mi></mrow></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">F^{sl}_{sel}</annotation></semantics></math>)</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 21.65 13.78)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:31.37em;--ltx-fo-height:63.15em;--ltx-fo-depth:0em;font-size:10pt;" height="873.82" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 873.82)" width="434.07"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:31.37em;">
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** TASK CONTEXT ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You are a Lead Data Architect. You have a Logical Plan to answer a query.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.3.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Your task: **Positive Selection**. Identify database tables or columns that are **RELEVANT** or **NECESSARY** to the plan.

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** USER QUESTION ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.5" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.5.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">question

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.6" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.6.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** MASTER LOGICAL PLAN</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.7" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.7.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{logical_plan}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.8" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.8.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** FULL DATABASE SCHEMA ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.9" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.9.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{schema}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.10" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.10.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** EVIDENCE ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.11" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.11.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{evidence}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.12" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.12.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** STRICT GUIDELINES ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.13" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.13.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">1. **High Recall (Safety)**: Select ALL columns that might be useful for joining, filtering, grouping, or returning results. If you are not sure about the relevance of a column, e.g., the name and the description are ambiguous, **PICK IT**.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.14" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.14.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">2. **Definition of Relevance**: Relevance includes both **Lexical Matching** and **Semantic Relatedness** over column name and description.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.15" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.15.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- **Lexical**: If a word from the query appears in the table or column name (e.g., query mentions "school" -&gt; keep ‘school_code‘, ‘school_type‘, etc.), it MUST be selected.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.16" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.16.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- **Semantic**: Identify columns conceptually related to the topic. For example, if the query asks about "patents that were granted in …", then the column ‘grant_date‘ should be kept.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.17" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.17.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- **Discriminators**: ALWAYS select primary keys and common identifiers (‘xxx_id‘, ‘xxx_code‘, ‘xxx_name‘) for relevant tables, as they are needed for joins.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.18" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.18.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">3. **Output Selection List**:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.19" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.19.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- **Tables**: If a whole table is relevant, list it in ‘relevant_tables‘.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.20" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.20.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- **Columns**: List specific useful columns in ‘relevant_columns‘. If a table is already listed in ‘relevant_tables‘, the columns can be omitted.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.21" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.21.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">4. **Grouped Tables**: If multiple tables are presented as sharing the same columns, you MUST list the selection instructions for **EACH** table explicitly. Pay close attention to name differences within the group (e.g., xx_2017 vs xx_2026), as these reflect specific data dimensions (like time) that determine relevance to the query.

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.22" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.22.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** OUTPUT FORMAT ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.23" class="ltx_p"><code id="A1.p6.pic1.2.23.1" class="ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">```</code><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.23.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">json</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.24" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.24.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.25" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.25.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"relevant_tables": ["table_useful_1"],</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.26" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.26.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"relevant_columns": [</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.27" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.27.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.28" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.28.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"table": "t1",</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.29" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.29.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"columns": ["col_useful_1", "col_pk_id"]</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.30" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.30.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">}</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.31" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.31.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">]</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.32" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.32.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">}</span></span>
<span id="A1.p6.pic1.2.33" class="ltx_p"><code id="A1.p6.pic1.2.33.1" class="ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">```</code></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>

<span id="A1.p7.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Semantic Linking (<math id="A1.p7.pic1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="F^{sl}_{semantics}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">F</mi><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">e</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">m</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">a</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">n</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">t</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">i</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">c</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">s</mi></mrow><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">s</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">l</mi></mrow></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">F^{sl}_{semantics}</annotation></semantics></math>)</span></span>

<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:31.37em;">
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** TASK CONTEXT ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You are a Senior Data Architect. You have full visibility of the database schema and a user question.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.3.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Your goal is to perform **Semantic Linking**: Analyze the database structure and how it grounds the user’s intent.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{CRITICAL_RULES}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.5" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.5.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** USER QUESTION ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.6" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.6.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{question}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.7" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.7.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** Logical Plan ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.8" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.8.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{logical_plan}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.9" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.9.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** Evidence ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.10" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.10.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{evidence}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.11" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.11.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** DATABASE SCHEMA ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.12" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.12.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{schema}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.13" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.13.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** YOUR TASKS ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.14" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.14.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">1. **Database Structure Overview**: Describe the database structure in detail (e.g., ’A banking system with customers and transactions…’).</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.15" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.15.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">2. **Query-Specific Content Analysis**: Analyze the query against the available columns. Identify which columns are likely targets, filters, or join keys.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.16" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.16.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">3. **Table Functional Analysis**: For EVERY potentially relevant table, describe its specific function regarding this query.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.17" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.17.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Is it a **Target Table**? (Contains the answer columns)</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.18" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.18.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Is it a **Bridge Table**? (Doesn’t have semantic data but is needed to join Table A and Table B via Foreign Keys)</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.19" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.19.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Is it a **Filtering Table**? (Contains columns for WHERE clauses)</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.20" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.20.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- **CRITICAL**: A table may have multiple roles. If a table is needed as a BRIDGE, you MUST explicitly state that it connects Entity X and Entity Y, even if it looks empty of content.

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.21" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.21.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** OUTPUT FORMAT ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.22" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.22.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.23" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.23.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"database_structure": "Database structure overview…",</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.24" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.24.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"query_specific_content_analysis": "Detailed mapping of query terms to DB columns/logic…",</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.25" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.25.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"table_functions": {</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.26" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.26.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"table_name_1": "Acts as a bridge table connecting Students and Classes via student_id and class_id.",</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.27" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.27.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"table_name_2": "Contains the ’score’ column needed for calculation and ’exam_date’ for filtering."</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.28" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.28.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">}</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.29" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.29.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">}</span></span>
<span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.30" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p7.pic1.2.30.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Perform the semantic linking analysis:</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</div>

<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:31.37em;">
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** TASK CONTEXT ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You are an agent exploring a database table to verify its relevance to a user question.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.3.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You must not explore randomly. You must verify if this table fits its anticipated role.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{CRITICAL_RULES}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.5" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.5.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** TARGET TABLE: {table_name} ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.6" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.6.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Columns:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.7" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.7.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{column_name} ({column_type}): {column_description}</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.8" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.8.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">…

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.9" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.9.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** USER QUESTION ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.10" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.10.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{question}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.11" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.11.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** ANTICIPATED ROLE ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.12" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.12.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">This table was identified as: {semantic_role}. Use this to guide your exploration.

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.13" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.13.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** Evidence ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.14" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.14.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{evidence}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.15" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.15.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** YOUR MISSION ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.16" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.16.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Generate 3-8 SQLite queries to investigate. **Focus on understanding the table’s semantics and utility.**

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.17" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.17.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">**Motivation for Exploration**:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.18" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.18.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">1. **Semantic Alignment**: Check distinct values to understand what the column *means* versus what the query *needs*. (e.g., If column is ’type’, does it contain the specific categories? If ’status’, does it contain values like ’Active’ or code ’1’?)</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.19" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.19.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">2. **Granularity &amp; Scope**: Verify the table’s grain (e.g., is it one row per Order or per Item?). This determines if it supports the required aggregations.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.20" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.20.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">3. **Bridge/Connectivity**: If this looks like a linking table, verify the Foreign Keys are populated (not all NULL) to ensure it can actually serve as a bridge.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.21" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.21.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">4. **Data Quality**: Are critical columns (targets for filters or answers) usable, or are they mostly NULL?

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.22" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.22.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** OUTPUT FORMAT ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.23" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.23.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Provide SQL queries in a single ‘sql‘ block with comments explaining the *motivation*.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.24" class="ltx_p"><code id="A1.p8.pic1.2.24.1" class="ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">```</code><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.24.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">sql</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.25" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.25.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">– Motivation: Checking distinct values in ’status’ to see if it aligns with the query’s filter requirement</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.26" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.26.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">SELECT DISTINCT status FROM table_name LIMIT 10;</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.27" class="ltx_p"><code id="A1.p8.pic1.2.27.1" class="ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">```</code><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.27.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.28" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.28.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Generate your exploration queries:

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.29" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.29.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">[<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.29.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">After Profiling …</span>]

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.30" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.30.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** TASK ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.31" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.31.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Based on the exploration history and results above, determine if table ‘{table_name}‘ is RELEVANT to the User Question.

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.32" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.32.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** EXPLORATION EVIDENCE ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.33" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.33.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{observations}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.34" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.34.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** USER QUESTION ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.35" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.35.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{question}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.36" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.36.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** EVIDENCE ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.37" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.37.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{evidence}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.38" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.38.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** DECISION GUIDELINES ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.39" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.39.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- **Direct Match**: Contains the specific answer data.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.40" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.40.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- **Bridge Table**: Contains IDs needed to join other relevant tables (CRITICAL: Keep even if no other useful data).</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.41" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.41.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- **Filter Source**: Contains columns needed to restrict the result.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.42" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.42.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- **Calculation Support**: Contains numerical columns needed for aggregation (e.g., ‘score‘ for AVG, ‘price‘ for SUM).

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.43" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.43.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** OUTPUT GUIDELINES ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.44" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.44.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- ‘relevance_reason‘: Explain the LOGICAL role (e.g., ’Provides the Join Key for X and Y’, ’Contains the target column Z’).</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.45" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.45.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- ‘observations‘: Summarize FACTUAL findings from exploration (e.g., ’Column A contains integer codes 1-5’, ’Table is empty’).</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.46" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.46.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- ‘table_summary‘: A concise summary of what this table represents in the context of the query.

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.47" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.47.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** OUTPUT FORMAT ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.48" class="ltx_p"><code id="A1.p8.pic1.2.48.1" class="ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">```</code><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.48.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">json</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.49" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.49.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.50" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.50.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"relevant": true/false,</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.51" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.51.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"relevant_columns": [</span></span>

<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.54" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.54.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"relevance_reason": "…",</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.55" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.55.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"observations": "…"</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.56" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.56.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">}</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.57" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.57.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">],</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.58" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.58.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"table_summary": "…"</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.59" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.59.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">}</span></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.60" class="ltx_p"><code id="A1.p8.pic1.2.60.1" class="ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">```</code></span>
<span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.61" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p8.pic1.2.61.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Provide your analysis:</span></span>

<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:31.37em;">
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** TASK CONTEXT ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You are the Lead Data Architect. We are synthesizing initial exploration findings.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.3.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Review the [MARKED RELEVANT] and [MARKED IRRELEVANT] tables. Fix blind spots.

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** USER QUESTION ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.5" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.5.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{question}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.6" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.6.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** EVIDENCE ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.7" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.7.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{question}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.8" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.8.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** SEMANTIC ANALYSIS ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.9" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.9.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{db_summary}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.10" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.10.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** SCHEMA STATUS ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.11" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.11.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Table: {t_name} [MARKED RELEVANT/MARKED IRRELEVANT]</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.12" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.12.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Columns:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.13" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.13.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{column_name} ({column_type}): {column_description}</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.14" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.14.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Observations: {observations}</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.15" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.15.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Reason: {reason}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.16" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.16.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** YOUR MISSION ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.17" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.17.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Determine the final list of columns required to write the SQL query.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.18" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.18.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You must ensure the selected columns form a connected graph (tables can be joined) and cover all functional requirements of the query.

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.19" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.19.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** SELECTION CRITERIA (FUNCTIONALITY) ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.20" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.20.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Keep a column if it serves one of the following purposes:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.21" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.21.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">1. **Identification**: Unique identifiers (IDs, Codes) needed to count or distinguish entities (Primary keys).</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.22" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.22.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">2. **Linking**: Columns needed to join two tables together (Foreign Keys).</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.23" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.23.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">3. **Filtering**: Columns involved in conditions (e.g., status=’Active’, date &gt; 2023).</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.24" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.24.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">4. **Aggregation**: Numerical columns for calculations (Sum, Avg, Max, Min).</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.25" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.25.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">5. **Grouping &amp; Sorting**: Columns used for ’GROUP BY’ or ’ORDER BY’.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.26" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.26.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">6. **Direct Result**: Columns explicitly requested in the output.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.27" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.27.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">**Note on Multi-Path**: If multiple columns might serve the same purpose, KEEP ALL OF THEM. Alternative columns might help to construct another solution paths.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.28" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.28.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">**Note on Type of Entity**: DO NOT guess the type of an unspecified entity even you have some prior knowledge, e.g., if the query contains location entity like ’Riverside’, then ALL columns related to location (e.g., County, District, etc.) should be kept. Another example is ’Fresno County Office of Education’ which is actually a full name of a district.

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.29" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.29.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** REJECTION REQUIREMENTS ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.30" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.30.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">If a column was marked as **[MARKED RELEVANT]** in the Schema Status but you decide to **REJECT** it, you MUST include it in the ‘rejected_candidates‘ list with a ‘reject_reason‘ explaining why it is unnecessary. You can NOT reject a column for the reason that it is only a potentially useful column.

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.31" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.31.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** INTERACTIVE PROCESS ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.32" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.32.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You can perform up to MAX_REFINE_ROUNDS rounds of verification.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.33" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.33.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- To EXPLORE: Output ‘exploration_queries‘ in JSON to test joins or content.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.34" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.34.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- To FINISH: Output ‘[CONFIRM]‘ in the JSON (or just output the final refined_schema without queries).

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.35" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.35.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** OUTPUT FORMAT ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.36" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.36.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You MUST explicitly list rejected candidates to prove you considered them.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.37" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.37.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">**IMPORTANT**: In ’rejected_candidates’, ONLY list columns that were previously marked RELEVANT but you decided to reject, OR columns that look ambiguous. Do NOT list obviously irrelevant columns to save space.

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.38" class="ltx_p"><code id="A1.p9.pic1.2.38.1" class="ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">```</code><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.38.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">json</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.39" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.39.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.40" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.40.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"refined_schema": {</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.41" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.41.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"table_name": {</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.42" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.42.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"relevant_columns": [</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.43" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.43.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.44" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.44.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"column_name": "…",</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.45" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.45.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"relevance_reason": "Functional reason (e.g., Needed for Filtering)"</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.46" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.46.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">}</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.47" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.47.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">]</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.48" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.48.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">}</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.49" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.49.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">},</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.50" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.50.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"rejected_candidates": [</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.51" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.51.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.52" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.52.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"table": "t1",</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.53" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.53.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"column": "c1",</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.54" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.54.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"reject_reason": "Originally marked relevant, but rejected because…"</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.55" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.55.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">}</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.56" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.56.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">],</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.57" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.57.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"exploration_queries": ["SELECT 1 FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id=t2.id LIMIT 1"],</span></span>
<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.58" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.58.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">"status": "EXPLORING" or "[CONFIRM]"</span></span>

<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.60" class="ltx_p"><code id="A1.p9.pic1.2.60.1" class="ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">```</code><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.60.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">

<span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.61" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p9.pic1.2.61.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Begin refinement:</span></span>

<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You are refining a logical plan. For each step, think about:
1. What information is needed</span></span>
<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">2. Different ways to obtain it (direct access, join, calculation, etc.)</span></span>
<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.3.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">3. Keywords that describe the operation

<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">QUESTION: {question}</span></span>

<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.6" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.6.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Schema: {Schema}</span></span>
<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.7" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.7.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">CURRENT PLAN: {Logical Plan}

<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.8" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.8.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">YOUR TASK:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.9" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.9.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Refine the plan by analyzing each step. For each step, provide:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.10" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.10.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Step N: [Brief description]</span></span>
<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.11" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.11.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Info need: [What information is required]</span></span>
<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.12" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.12.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Possible paths: [List 2-3 ways to get this info, e.g., ’direct column X’, ’join tables A-B’, ’calculate using formula’]</span></span>
<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.13" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.13.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Keywords: [table names, column names, operations like filter/join/aggregate, concepts]</span></span>
<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.14" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.14.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Evidence: [exact evidence text if applicable]

<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.15" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.15.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">EXAMPLE:</span></span>

<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.19" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.19.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Keywords: schools, school_type, EILCode, filter, high school</span></span>
<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.20" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.20.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Evidence: EILCode = ’HS’ means high school

<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.21" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.21.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Step 2: Calculate average score</span></span>
<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.22" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.22.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Info need: Average of scores</span></span>
<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.23" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.23.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Possible paths: ’AVG(score_column)’, ’SUM/COUNT formula’, ’pre-computed avg_score column’</span></span>
<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.24" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.24.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Keywords: scores, average, AVG, aggregate, calculation

<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.25" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.25.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">IMPORTANT:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.26" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.26.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Focus ONLY on the logical steps needed to answer the question</span></span>
<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.27" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.27.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Do NOT specify output columns in this plan</span></span>
<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.28" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.28.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Evidence: preserve EXACTLY (formulas, column names, values)</span></span>
<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.29" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.29.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Paths: list alternatives naturally (don’t force if only one way makes sense)</span></span>
<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.30" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.30.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Keywords: comprehensive but relevant</span></span>
<span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.31" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p10.pic1.2.31.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Keep plan abstract (avoid specific table/column names unless from evidence)

<span id="A1.p11.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Action Space Definition (<math id="A1.p11.pic1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{A}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic" mathcolor="#000000">𝒜</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{A}</annotation></semantics></math>)</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 21.65 17.24)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:31.37em;--ltx-fo-height:76.3em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.25em;font-size:10pt;" height="1059.16" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 1055.7)" width="434.07"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:31.37em;">
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You are an expert SQL query generator. Your task is to convert natural language questions into SQL queries.

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"># AVAILABLE ACTIONS</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.3.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">**CRITICAL**: Always start your response with EXACTLY ONE action tag ([EXPLORE], [REFINE], [SQL], or [CONFIRM]) at the very beginning.

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">## [EXPLORE]</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.5" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.5.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Execute SQL queries to explore database content and gather evidence.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.6" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.6.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Use this when you need to:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.7" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.7.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Discover possible values in a column (e.g., DISTINCT values)</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.8" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.8.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Verify data formats or patterns</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.9" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.9.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Check relationships between tables</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.10" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.10.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Gather sample data to understand the database

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.11" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.11.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">**Exploration Guidelines**:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.12" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.12.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Use LIMIT to restrict output when exploring specific values or samples.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.13" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.13.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- If you need to understand data distribution (e.g., range, distinct values), you may omit LIMIT. For large results (&gt;30 rows), we will report: max value, min value, data format, and distinct values.

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.14" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.14.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">**Format**: Start with [EXPLORE] tag, then write SQL queries with comments:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.15" class="ltx_p"><code id="A1.p11.pic1.2.15.1" class="ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">```</code></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.16" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.16.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">[EXPLORE]</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.17" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.17.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">– Purpose: Check available product categories</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.18" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.18.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products LIMIT 10;</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.19" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.19.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">– Purpose: Verify date format</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.20" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.20.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">SELECT date_column FROM orders LIMIT 5;</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.21" class="ltx_p"><code id="A1.p11.pic1.2.21.1" class="ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">```</code></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.22" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.22.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">**Important**: After exploration, please use [REFINE] to analyze the results before generating SQL.

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.23" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.23.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">## [REFINE]</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.24" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.24.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Analyze exploration results, update your understanding, and plan the next steps.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.25" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.25.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Use this to:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.26" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.26.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Summarize what you learned from exploration and the remaining problems</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.27" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.27.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Update your logical plan</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.28" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.28.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Plan the SQL query structure (JOINs, filters, aggregations, etc.)</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.29" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.29.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Decide if more exploration is needed or if you’re ready to generate SQL

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.30" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.30.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">**Format**: Start with [REFINE] tag, then provide structured reasoning:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.31" class="ltx_p"><code id="A1.p11.pic1.2.31.1" class="ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">```</code></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.32" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.32.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">[REFINE]</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.33" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.33.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">### Findings from Exploration:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.34" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.34.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- [Summarize key discoveries]</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.35" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.35.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">### Updated Understanding:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.36" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.36.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- [How this changes your approach]</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.37" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.37.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">### Query Plan:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.38" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.38.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- [Step-by-step plan for the SQL query]</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.39" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.39.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">### Next Action:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.40" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.40.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- [EXPLORE more] OR [Generate SQL]</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.41" class="ltx_p"><code id="A1.p11.pic1.2.41.1" class="ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">```</code><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.41.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.42" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.42.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">## [SQL]</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.43" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.43.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Generate the final SQL query.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.44" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.44.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Use this when you are confident about the query logic.

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.45" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.45.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">**Format**: Start with [SQL] tag, then provide the query:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.46" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.46.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">[SQL] <code id="A1.p11.pic1.2.46.1.1" class="ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter">```</code>sql &lt;Your SQL query&gt; <code id="A1.p11.pic1.2.46.1.2" class="ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter">```</code>

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.47" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.47.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">## [CONFIRM]</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.48" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.48.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Confirm the logic of the generated SQLs and the final result after SQL execution.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.49" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.49.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Use this ONLY after [SQL] execution returns a satisfactory result.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.50" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p11.pic1.2.50.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">**Format**: [CONFIRM] &lt;Brief description of what the query does&gt;</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</div>
<div id="A1.p12" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A1.p12.pic1" class="ltx_picture" height="709.57" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 477.38 709.57" width="477.38"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,709.57) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#B3B336;" fill="#B3B336" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 15.81 L 0 693.77 C 0 702.5 7.08 709.57 15.81 709.57 L 461.57 709.57 C 470.3 709.57 477.38 702.5 477.38 693.77 L 477.38 15.81 C 477.38 7.08 470.3 0 461.57 0 L 15.81 0 C 7.08 0 0 7.08 0 15.81 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#FFFFE6;" fill="#FFFFE6" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 1.97 15.81 L 1.97 685.46 L 475.41 685.46 L 475.41 15.81 C 475.41 8.16 469.21 1.97 461.57 1.97 L 15.81 1.97 C 8.16 1.97 1.97 8.16 1.97 15.81 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#FFFF99;" fill="#FFFF99" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 1.97 687.43 L 1.97 693.77 C 1.97 701.41 8.16 707.6 15.81 707.6 L 461.57 707.6 C 469.21 707.6 475.41 701.41 475.41 693.77 L 475.41 687.43 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 21.65 694.06)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:31.37em;--ltx-fo-height:0.69em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.19em;font-size:10pt;" height="12.3" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 9.61)" width="434.07"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:31.37em;">
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Evidence Linking</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 21.65 16.47)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:31.37em;--ltx-fo-height:47.49em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.19em;font-size:10pt;" height="659.88" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 657.19)" width="434.07"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:31.37em;">
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You are an expert Data Analyst Assistant supporting a Text-to-SQL system.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">We have a User Query and an External Knowledge Document (Markdown format) that contains business rules, calculation logic, or data dictionary definitions.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.3.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Your task is to **extract** every piece of information from the document that is relevant to the User Query.

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">### Input Information</span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.5" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.5.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- **User Query**: {query}</span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.6" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.6.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- **Knowledge File Name**: {knowledge_file_name}</span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.7" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.7.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- **Original Knowledge Content**:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.8" class="ltx_p"><code id="A1.p12.pic1.2.8.1" class="ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">```</code><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.8.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">markdown</span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.9" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.9.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{knowledge_content}</span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.10" class="ltx_p"><code id="A1.p12.pic1.2.10.1" class="ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">```</code><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.10.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.11" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.11.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">### Extraction Instructions (CRITICAL)</span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.12" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.12.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">1. **Goal: High Recall (Better Safe Than Sorry).**</span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.13" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.13.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- If any section, paragraph, definition, description, entity code, formula, or table row is **potentially** related to the entities, metrics, conditions, constraints, or logic in the query (even slightly), **KEEP IT**.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.14" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.14.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Do NOT try to be concise. We prefer extra context over missing information.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.15" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.15.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Only remove content that is obviously and strictly irrelevant (e.g., legacy codes not mentioned, definitions of completely unrelated departments).</span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.16" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.16.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">2. **Maintain Context &amp; Integrity.**</span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.17" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.17.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Do NOT pick out single words or fragmented sentences.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.18" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.18.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Keep entire paragraphs, list items, or table rows to ensure the context remains readable and authentic.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.19" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.19.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- If a calculation rule depends on previous lines (like a variable definition), include those lines too.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.20" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.20.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">3. **Do Not Rewrite.**</span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.21" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.21.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Do NOT summarize, paraphrase, or change the original text. **Copy and paste** the relevant sections exactly as they appear in the source.

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.22" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.22.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">### Output</span></span>
<span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.23" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p12.pic1.2.23.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Output ONLY the extracted markdown content below, without any introductory or concluding text.</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</div>
<div id="A1.p13" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A1.p13.pic1" class="ltx_picture" height="870.24" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 477.38 870.24" width="477.38"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,870.24) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#B3B336;" fill="#B3B336" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 15.81 L 0 854.43 C 0 863.16 7.08 870.24 15.81 870.24 L 461.57 870.24 C 470.3 870.24 477.38 863.16 477.38 854.43 L 477.38 15.81 C 477.38 7.08 470.3 0 461.57 0 L 15.81 0 C 7.08 0 0 7.08 0 15.81 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#FFFFE6;" fill="#FFFFE6" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 1.97 15.81 L 1.97 848.82 L 475.41 848.82 L 475.41 15.81 C 475.41 8.16 469.21 1.97 461.57 1.97 L 15.81 1.97 C 8.16 1.97 1.97 8.16 1.97 15.81 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#FFFF99;" fill="#FFFF99" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 1.97 850.78 L 1.97 854.43 C 1.97 862.07 8.16 868.27 15.81 868.27 L 461.57 868.27 C 469.21 868.27 475.41 862.07 475.41 854.43 L 475.41 850.78 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 21.65 854.72)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:31.37em;--ltx-fo-height:0.69em;--ltx-fo-depth:0em;font-size:10pt;" height="9.61" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 9.61)" width="434.07"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:31.37em;">
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Answer Selection</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 21.65 13.78)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:31.37em;--ltx-fo-height:59.5em;--ltx-fo-depth:0em;font-size:10pt;" height="823.23" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 823.23)" width="434.07"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:31.37em;">
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You are a Senior Data Architect acting as a Judge. You are provided with a User Question, the Database Schema, and several Candidate Solutions generated by an AI agent.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Each candidate consists of:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.3.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">1. **The Execution Strategy**: The logic derived after exploring the database (identifying specific tables, columns, and values).</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">2. **The Final SQL**: The query implementation (We have varified that the SQL is executable).</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.5" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.5.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">**YOUR GOAL**: Identify the SINGLE best candidate that is most likely to execute correctly and return the accurate answer.

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.6" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.6.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** DATABASE SCHEMA ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.7" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.7.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{schema}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.8" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.8.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** USER QUESTION ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.9" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.9.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{question}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.10" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.10.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** CANDIDATES ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.11" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.11.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{candidates}

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.12" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.12.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** EVALUATION CRITERIA (Prioritize in this order) ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.13" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.13.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">1. **Specificity of Evidence (The "Verified" Test)**:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.14" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.14.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- **Favor** candidates where the Strategy explicitly lists *verified values* found during exploration.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.15" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.15.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- **Reject** candidates with vague strategies (e.g., "Filter by population metric" without stating *which* metric ID).
2. **Entity Isolation (The "Explosion" Test)**:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.16" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.16.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- Look at the Schema. If a table contains mixed data types (e.g., ‘MetricID‘, ‘EventType‘, ‘Year‘), the SQL **MUST** filter for a specific value.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.17" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.17.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- **Reject** candidates that aggregate a Fact/Event table without a ‘WHERE‘ clause filtering for the specific metric/type (this leads to wrong sums).</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.18" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.18.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">3. **Logic Robustness (The "Safety" Test)**:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.19" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.19.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- **Ratios**: The SQL should handle zero denominators (e.g., ‘WHERE denom &gt; 0‘ or ‘NULLIF‘).</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.20" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.20.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- **Joins**: If the task involves multiple independent event tables (e.g., Sends, Opens), **Favor** candidates using ‘UNION ALL‘ or ‘FULL JOIN‘ strategies over simple ‘INNER/LEFT JOIN‘ which might lose data.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.21" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.21.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">4. **Consistency**:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.22" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.22.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">- The SQL must strictly follow the Strategy. If the Strategy says "Filter X" but SQL does not, reject it.

<br class="ltx_break"></span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.23" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.23.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">*** OUTPUT INSTRUCTION ***</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.24" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.24.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">1. Analyze each candidate one by one based on the criteria above.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.25" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.25.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">2. Compare the candidates (both the strategy and the SQL) to point out if some of them miss necessary filters (Entity Isolation) or lacks specific verified details.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.26" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.26.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">3. Select the best candidate.</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.27" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.27.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">4. Output the chosen file name in this format:</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.28" class="ltx_p"><code id="A1.p13.pic1.2.28.1" class="ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">```</code><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.28.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">plaintext</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.29" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.29.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">xxx.sql</span></span>
<span id="A1.p13.pic1.2.30" class="ltx_p"><code id="A1.p13.pic1.2.30.1" class="ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">```</code></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</div>
<figure id="A1.T7" class="ltx_table">
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_table">Table 7. </span>Execution accuracy versus token consumption on BIRD-Dev. Due to limited reporting in existing literature, token statistics are provided only for a subset of baselines. Specific sources and their respective table references are listed in the Source and Note columns. <span id="A1.T7.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">APEX-SQL</span> demonstrates a competitive accuracy with a notable reduction in token overhead.</figcaption>
<table id="A1.T7.4" class="ltx_tabular ltx_centering ltx_guessed_headers ltx_align_middle">

<section id="A2" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix B </span>Token Consumption Analysis</h2>

<section id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">BIRD-Dev</h5>

<div id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">As a supplement to Table <a href="#S4.T2" title="Table 2 ‣ 4.2.5. Schema Linking Details ‣ 4.2. Experiment 1: Schema Linking Performance ‣ 4. Experiments ‣ APEX-SQL: Talking to the data via Agentic Exploration for Text-to-SQL" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2</span></a>, we collect token consumption statistics for baselines from publicly available reports, as summarized in Table <a href="#A1.T7" title="Table 7 ‣ Appendix A Instruction Templates ‣ APEX-SQL: Talking to the data via Agentic Exploration for Text-to-SQL" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">7</span></a>. The results show that while some high-performing systems (e.g., CHESS-SQL) consume over 300k tokens per query, <span id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">APEX-SQL</span> achieves superior accuracy with only 3.7k tokens. Compared to lightweight methods like DAIL-SQL, <span id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">APEX-SQL</span> provides a substantial gain in execution accuracy with only a marginal increase in token usage. These findings indicate that agentic exploration is more cost-effective than passive strategies, enabling robust performance with significantly lower inference overhead.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Spider 2.0-Snow</h5>

<div id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We analyze token consumption of different methods on Spider 2.0-Snow in Table <a href="#S4.T3" title="Table 3 ‣ 4.3.2. Baselines ‣ 4.3. Experiment 2: SQL Generation Performance ‣ 4. Experiments ‣ APEX-SQL: Talking to the data via Agentic Exploration for Text-to-SQL" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">3</span></a>. Our approach effectively improves performance while reducing token usage, demonstrating the efficiency of agentic exploration.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A3" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix C </span>Tip Library Details</h2>

<div id="A3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">This document presents the complete tip library <math id="A3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{M}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℳ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{M}</annotation></semantics></math> used for SQL generation guidance (Section <a href="#S3.SS3.SSS1" title="3.3.1. Guidance via Deterministic Retrieval ‣ 3.3. Agentic Exploration for SQL Generation ‣ 3. Methodology ‣ APEX-SQL: Talking to the data via Agentic Exploration for Text-to-SQL" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">3.3.1</span></a>). The library contains 49 tips organized into 14 categories. We use DeepSeek-V3.2 to analyze a randomly selected 10% of BIRD-train cases to extract these tips. Each tip is formatted as it appears in the actual case prompts: [TIP_ID] Title followed by Description.</p>
</div>
<section id="A3.SS1" class="ltx_subsection">
