<section id="A3.SS2" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">C.2. </span>Complete Tip Listing</h3>

<section id="A3.SS2.SSS1" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">C.2.1. </span>Category: Evidence Enforcement</h4>

<div id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span> 
<br class="ltx_break"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP001]</span> Evidence-Specified Column Must Be Used Exactly</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p2.1" class="ltx_p">When evidence specifies a column name, explore using that exact column. Do NOT substitute with similar columns.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP002]</span> Evidence-Specified Formula Must Be Implemented Exactly</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p4.1" class="ltx_p">When evidence provides a calculation formula, explore implementing it EXACTLY as specified. Do NOT use built-in functions that seem equivalent.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p5" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP003]</span> Evidence-Specified Value Must Be Used Exactly</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p6" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p6.1" class="ltx_p">When evidence provides value mappings, explore using the EXACT database value, not the English translation or interpretation.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p7" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p7.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP004]</span> Evidence Clarifies Ambiguous Terms</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p8" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p8.1" class="ltx_p">When evidence clarifies which column or table an ambiguous term refers to, explore following the evidence interpretation.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p9" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p9.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p9.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP044]</span> Evidence Formula Preservation - No Rephrasing Allowed</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p10" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p10.1" class="ltx_p">When evidence provides a formula or calculation method, explore preserving it EXACTLY. Do NOT rephrase, simplify, or use ’equivalent’ built-in functions.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p11" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p11.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p11.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP045]</span> WHERE Clause from Evidence - Extract Exact Conditions</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p12" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS1.p12.1" class="ltx_p">When evidence specifies how to filter data (column names, values, or conditions), explore extracting and implementing these EXACTLY.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS2.SSS2" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">C.2.2. </span>Category: String Matching</h4>

<div id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span> 
<br class="ltx_break"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP005]</span> Use Exact Match (=) When Value Is Known</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p2.1" class="ltx_p">When question or evidence provides a specific value, explore using exact match (=). Only use LIKE for partial matching.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP006]</span> Use LIKE Only for Partial Matching</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p4.1" class="ltx_p">Explore using LIKE only when question explicitly asks for partial matching (contains, starts with, ends with).</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p5" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP007]</span> After Exploration, Use Exact Values Not Patterns</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p6" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p6.1" class="ltx_p">After exploring to find possible values, use exact match (=) with the found value to explore, not LIKE pattern.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p7" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p7.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP025]</span> Choose String Matching Strategy Based on Question Intent</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p8" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS2.p8.1" class="ltx_p">Explore choosing between exact match (=), prefix match (LIKE ’X%’), suffix match (LIKE ’%X’), or contains (LIKE ’%X%’) based on question.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS2.SSS3" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">C.2.3. </span>Category: Output Columns</h4>

<div id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span> 
<br class="ltx_break"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP008]</span> Exclude ORDER BY Columns from SELECT Unless Requested</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p2.1" class="ltx_p">Explore excluding columns used only for sorting (ORDER BY) from SELECT unless explicitly requested in question.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP009]</span> Return Columns in Exact Order Mentioned in Question</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p4.1" class="ltx_p">Explore returning output columns in the EXACT order they appear in the question. First mentioned → first in SELECT.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p5" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP010]</span> Exclude Filter Columns from SELECT Unless Requested</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p6" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p6.1" class="ltx_p">Explore excluding columns used only for filtering (WHERE) from SELECT unless explicitly requested.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p7" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p7.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP011]</span> For ’How Many’ Questions, Return COUNT Only</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p8" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p8.1" class="ltx_p">When question asks ’how many’, explore returning only COUNT, not individual records or other columns.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p9" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p9.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p9.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP043]</span> SELECT Clause Precision - Return ONLY Requested Columns</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p10" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS3.p10.1" class="ltx_p">Explore ensuring the SELECT clause returns ONLY the columns explicitly requested in the question, in the exact order mentioned.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS2.SSS4" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">C.2.4. </span>Category: Table Selection</h4>

<div id="A3.SS2.SSS4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span> 
<br class="ltx_break"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS4.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP012]</span> Check If Single Table Contains All Required Information</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS4.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS4.p2.1" class="ltx_p">Before exploring JOIN, verify if all required information exists in a single table. Prefer exploring single-table solutions.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS4.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS4.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS4.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP013]</span> JOIN Only When Information Spans Multiple Tables</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS4.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS4.p4.1" class="ltx_p">Explore using JOIN only when question explicitly needs information from multiple entities that exist in different tables.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS4.p5" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS4.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS4.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP014]</span> Avoid Over-Engineering with Unnecessary Complexity</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS4.p6" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS4.p6.1" class="ltx_p">Explore avoiding JOINs, subqueries, or conditions that aren’t needed. Use the simplest solution that answers the question.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS2.SSS5" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">C.2.5. </span>Category: Column Interpretation</h4>

<div id="A3.SS2.SSS5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS5.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS5.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span> 
<br class="ltx_break"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS5.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP015]</span> Parenthetical Text in Column Names Is NOT a Filter Condition</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS5.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS5.p2.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring, note that text in parentheses within column names (e.g., ’(K-12)’, ’(Ages 5-17)’) is part of the column name, NOT a filter condition.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS5.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS5.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS5.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP016]</span> Distinguish Column Name Context from Filter Conditions</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS5.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS5.p4.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring, note that parenthetical text in column names provides context about the data, not additional filter conditions to apply.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS2.SSS6" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">C.2.6. </span>Category: Schema Grounding</h4>

<div id="A3.SS2.SSS6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS6.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS6.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span> 
<br class="ltx_break"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS6.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP017]</span> Use Direct Name Matching for Column Identification</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS6.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS6.p2.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring, if logical plan mentions a concept, look for columns with similar names first (case-insensitive, with variations).</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS6.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS6.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS6.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP018]</span> Use Semantic Matching When Direct Names Don’t Match</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS6.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS6.p4.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring, if direct name matching fails, think about what the concept means and look for semantically related columns.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS6.p5" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS6.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS6.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP019]</span> Always Verify Column Existence Before Using</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS6.p6" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS6.p6.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring, never assume a column exists. Always verify through exploration before using.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS2.SSS7" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">C.2.7. </span>Category: Join Strategy</h4>

<div id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span> 
<br class="ltx_break"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP020]</span> Identify Join Keys from Schema Relationships</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p2.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring joins, look for foreign key relationships in schema. Common patterns: ID columns, Code columns, Name columns.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP021]</span> Verify Join Keys Have Matching Values</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p4.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring joins, verify that join keys have matching values in both tables and check for NULLs.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p5" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP022]</span> Choose Appropriate Join Type</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p6" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p6.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring joins, select join type based on whether you need all records from one/both tables or only matching records.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p7" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p7.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP042]</span> Prefix Columns with Table Alias When Joining</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p8" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS7.p8.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring joins, prefix all columns with table alias to avoid ambiguous column errors.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS2.SSS8" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">C.2.8. </span>Category: Filter Implementation</h4>

<div id="A3.SS2.SSS8.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS8.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS8.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span> 
<br class="ltx_break"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS8.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP023]</span> Use Exact Value Filters When Value Is Specified</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS8.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS8.p2.1" class="ltx_p">When question explicitly mentions a value, explore using exact match (=) for filtering.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS8.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS8.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS8.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP024]</span> Use Correct Numeric Comparison Operators</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS8.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS8.p4.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring filters, translate question’s numeric comparisons to correct operators. Pay attention to inclusive vs exclusive. BETWEEN is inclusive on both ends.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS2.SSS9" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">C.2.9. </span>Category: Aggregation</h4>

<div id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span> 
<br class="ltx_break"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP026]</span> Choose Correct Aggregation Function</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p2.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring aggregations, select appropriate function based on what question asks: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MAX, MIN.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP027]</span> Protect Division Operations Against Zero and Use CAST</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p4.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring calculations with ratios or percentages, protect against division by zero and ensure float division with CAST.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p5" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP028]</span> Use GROUP BY When Aggregating Per Category</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p6" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p6.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring aggregations and question asks ’per category’, ’by group’, ’for each’, use GROUP BY with the category column.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p7" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p7.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP029]</span> Use HAVING to Filter After Aggregation</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p8" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p8.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring aggregations, use HAVING clause to filter groups after aggregation. Use WHERE to filter rows before aggregation.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p9" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p9.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p9.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP046]</span> Precision Preservation - No Arbitrary Rounding</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p10" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p10.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring calculations, do NOT apply ROUND() unless the question explicitly specifies precision requirements.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p11" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p11.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p11.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP047]</span> Ratio Calculation - Count All Occurrences</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p12" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p12.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring ratio or percentage calculations, count ALL occurrences (including duplicates) unless the question explicitly asks for DISTINCT counts.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p13" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p13.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p13.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP048]</span> Percentage Calculation - CAST to REAL and Multiply by 100</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p14" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p14.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring percentage calculations, always CAST the numerator to REAL before division, then multiply by 100.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p15" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p15.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p15.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP049]</span> DISTINCT Usage - List vs Count</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p16" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS9.p16.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring, use DISTINCT when listing entities (names, IDs, items) to avoid duplicates. Do NOT use DISTINCT when counting occurrences for statistical purposes unless explicitly asked for unique counts.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS2.SSS10" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">C.2.10. </span>Category: Sorting and Limiting</h4>

<div id="A3.SS2.SSS10.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS10.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS10.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span> 
<br class="ltx_break"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS10.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP030]</span> Implement ORDER BY Based on Question Keywords</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS10.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS10.p2.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring sorting, translate question’s keywords to correct ORDER BY direction: ASC for lowest/first, DESC for highest/last.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS10.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS10.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS10.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP031]</span> Use LIMIT for Top N or Single Extreme Value</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS10.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS10.p4.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring and question asks for ’top N’, ’first N’, or single extreme value, use LIMIT with ORDER BY.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS10.p5" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS10.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS10.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP032]</span> Filter Out NULLs When Finding Extreme Values</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS10.p6" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS10.p6.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring extreme values with ORDER BY, add WHERE column IS NOT NULL to avoid NULL results.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS2.SSS11" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">C.2.11. </span>Category: Multi-Step Logic</h4>

<div id="A3.SS2.SSS11.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS11.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS11.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span> 
<br class="ltx_break"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS11.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP033]</span> Use Subquery for Dependent Steps</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS11.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS11.p2.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring and logical plan has dependent steps (step 2 needs result from step 1), explore using subquery or CTE.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS11.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS11.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS11.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP034]</span> Use CTE for Complex Multi-Step Logic</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS11.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS11.p4.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring complex queries with multiple dependent steps, explore using CTE (WITH clause) for clarity.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS2.SSS12" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">C.2.12. </span>Category: SQL Syntax</h4>

<div id="A3.SS2.SSS12.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS12.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS12.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span> 
<br class="ltx_break"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS12.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP035]</span> Use Double Quotes for Identifiers with Spaces or Special Characters</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS12.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS12.p2.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring, note that column/table names with spaces, special characters, or reserved words must be quoted with double quotes.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS12.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS12.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS12.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP036]</span> Use Aliases for Calculated Columns</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS12.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS12.p4.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring calculations, give meaningful aliases to calculated columns, aggregations, and complex expressions using AS.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS12.p5" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS12.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS12.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP037]</span> Cannot Use Column Alias in WHERE Clause of Same Level</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS12.p6" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS12.p6.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring, note that column aliases defined in SELECT cannot be used in WHERE clause of the same query level. Use subquery or repeat expression.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS2.SSS13" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">C.2.13. </span>Category: Common Pitfalls</h4>

<div id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span> 
<br class="ltx_break"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP038]</span> Never Hard-Code Values Discovered in Exploration</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p2.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring, do NOT hard-code values you discovered unless they are explicitly mentioned in the question.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP039]</span> Handle NULL Values Appropriately</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p4.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring, be aware of NULL values in aggregations, comparisons, and joins. Filter or handle them explicitly.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p5" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP040]</span> Avoid Integer Division - Use CAST for Float Results</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p6" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p6.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring calculations in SQLite, note that dividing two integers gives integer result. Use CAST(x AS REAL) to get float result.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p7" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p7.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP041]</span> Apply Entity Isolation for Mixed-Data Tables</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p8" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS13.p8.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring tables with mixed entity types (e.g., different metrics in same table), filter by entity type before aggregating.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS2.SSS14" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">C.2.14. </span>Category: Advanced Patterns</h4>

<div id="A3.SS2.SSS14.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS14.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS14.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span> 
<br class="ltx_break"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS14.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP043]</span> Use Conditional Aggregation with CASE</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS14.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS14.p2.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring aggregations of different subsets in one query, use CASE inside aggregate functions.</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS14.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS14.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS14.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP044]</span> Use Window Functions for Ranking</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS14.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS14.p4.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring ranking, row numbering, or running calculations, use window functions (RANK, ROW_NUMBER, etc.).</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS14.p5" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS14.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS14.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">[TIP045]</span> Find Top N Per Group with Window Functions</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS2.SSS14.p6" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS14.p6.1" class="ltx_p">When exploring top N records per category, use ROW_NUMBER() with PARTITION BY, then filter.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS3" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">C.3. </span>Tip Retrieval Relationships</h3>

<div id="A3.SS3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The tip retrieval system uses rule-based keyword matching to select relevant tips for each question.</p>
</div>
<section id="A3.SS3.SSS1" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">C.3.1. </span>Universal Tips (Always Selected)</h4>

<div id="A3.SS3.SSS1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS3.SSS1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span> 
<br class="ltx_break">The following tips are included in every query regardless of content:
<span id="A3.SS3.SSS1.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP009</span>, <span id="A3.SS3.SSS1.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP019</span>, <span id="A3.SS3.SSS1.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP035</span>, and <span id="A3.SS3.SSS1.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP038</span>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS3.SSS2" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">C.3.2. </span>Evidence-Based Retrieval</h4>

<div id="A3.SS3.SSS2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Tips selected based on patterns detected in the evidence field:</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS3.SSS2.p2" class="ltx_para">
<ul id="A3.I2" class="ltx_itemize ltx_leftmargin_flush">
<li id="A3.I2.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I2.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I2.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Evidence contains phrases like "can be represented as [column]=" or "[column]=[value]" (excluding "refers to") → <span id="A3.I2.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP001</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I2.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I2.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I2.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Evidence contains formulas with arithmetic operators, or phrases like "sum of count" or "average =" → <span id="A3.I2.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP002, TIP027, TIP040</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I2.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I2.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I2.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Evidence contains "stands for" or "means" (with quoted values), or patterns like "’value’ stands for/means/is/are" → <span id="A3.I2.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP003</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I2.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I2.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I2.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Evidence contains "refers to" → <span id="A3.I2.i4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP004</span></p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS3.SSS3" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">C.3.3. </span>Question-Based Retrieval</h4>

<div id="A3.SS3.SSS3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Tips selected based on keywords and patterns in the question text:</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS3.SSS3.p2" class="ltx_para">
<ul id="A3.I3" class="ltx_itemize ltx_leftmargin_flush">
<li id="A3.I3.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I3.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I3.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question contains "with", "where", or "whose" followed by a quoted value → <span id="A3.I3.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP005, TIP023</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I3.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I3.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I3.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question contains: highest, lowest, top, bottom, maximum, minimum, best, worst, most, least, order by, sort → <span id="A3.I3.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP008, TIP030, TIP031, TIP032</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I3.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I3.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I3.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question mentions multiple outputs connected by "and" (e.g., "name and age"), but does NOT start with "how many" → <span id="A3.I3.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP009</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I3.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I3.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I3.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question starts with "what", "list", "name", or "show" and contains "where", "with", "whose", or "that have" → <span id="A3.I3.i4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP010</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I3.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I3.i5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I3.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question starts with "how many" (without "what" or "which"), or contains "list" + "lowest" + "amount" → <span id="A3.I3.i5.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP011</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I3.i6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I3.i6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I3.i6.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question or evidence contains parentheses → <span id="A3.I3.i6.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP015, TIP016</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I3.i7" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I3.i7.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I3.i7.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question contains: more than, less than, greater than, between, at least, at most, above, below, over, under, exceed → <span id="A3.I3.i7.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP024</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I3.i8" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I3.i8.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I3.i8.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question contains: total, sum, average, avg, count, maximum, minimum, aggregate, group by → <span id="A3.I3.i8.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP026, TIP028</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I3.i9" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I3.i9.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I3.i9.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question contains aggregation keywords (average, total, sum, count) combined with comparison keywords (more than, less than, greater, between) → <span id="A3.I3.i9.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP029</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I3.i10" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I3.i10.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I3.i10.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question contains: calculate, ratio, percentage, average → <span id="A3.I3.i10.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP036, TIP046</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I3.i11" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I3.i11.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I3.i11.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question contains: ratio, percentage, percent, proportion, rate → <span id="A3.I3.i11.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP047, TIP048</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I3.i12" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I3.i12.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I3.i12.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question starts with: how many, what is, what are, which, list all, list the → <span id="A3.I3.i12.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP049</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I3.i13" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I3.i13.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I3.i13.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question contains: contain, include, start with, end with, like → <span id="A3.I3.i13.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP006</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I3.i14" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I3.i14.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I3.i14.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question contains: name, title, description → <span id="A3.I3.i14.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP025</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I3.i15" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I3.i15.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I3.i15.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Question contains: null, missing, empty → <span id="A3.I3.i15.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP039</span></p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS3.SSS4" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">C.3.4. </span>Logical Plan-Based Retrieval</h4>

<div id="A3.SS3.SSS4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Tips selected based on patterns in the logical plan structure:</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS3.SSS4.p2" class="ltx_para">
<ul id="A3.I4" class="ltx_itemize ltx_leftmargin_flush">
<li id="A3.I4.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I4.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I4.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Plan contains "join", or mentions 4+ tables, or question contains patterns like "X and their/its Y" → <span id="A3.I4.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP012, TIP013, TIP020, TIP021, TIP022, TIP042</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I4.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I4.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I4.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Plan contains both "subquery" and "nested", or has 4+ occurrences of "join" → <span id="A3.I4.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP014</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I4.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I4.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I4.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Plan has 4+ steps, or contains both "subquery" and "nested", or uses CTE pattern (WITH…AS…SELECT) → <span id="A3.I4.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP033, TIP034</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I4.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I4.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I4.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Plan contains "case when", or contains both "different" and "aggregate" → <span id="A3.I4.i4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP043</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A3.I4.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I4.i5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I4.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Plan contains: rank, ranking, row number, top n per, per group, partition → <span id="A3.I4.i5.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP044, TIP045</span></p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS3.SSS5" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">C.3.5. </span>Schema-Based Retrieval</h4>

<div id="A3.SS3.SSS5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Tips selected based on database schema characteristics:</p>
</div>
<div id="A3.SS3.SSS5.p2" class="ltx_para">
<ul id="A3.I5" class="ltx_itemize ltx_leftmargin_flush">
<li id="A3.I5.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A3.I5.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.I5.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Schema contains entity type columns (metricid, metric_id, event_
<br class="ltx_break">type, entity_type, data_type) and question contains filtering keywords (specific, certain, particular, only, filter by type, where type) → <span id="A3.I5.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TIP041</span></p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div>
</section>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A4" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix D </span>Case Study</h2>

<div id="A4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">To demonstrate the effectiveness of agentic exploration in SQL generation, we present a representative case from the Spider 2.0-Snow benchmark. This case (<span id="A4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">sf_bq028</span>) illustrates how agentic exploration enables the model to discover critical data quality issues and adapt its strategy accordingly, leading to successful query generation where the baseline method failed.</p>
</div>
<section id="A4.SS1" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">D.1. </span>Case sf_bq028: Data Quality Discovery Through Exploration</h3>

<section id="A4.SS1.SSS1" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">D.1.1. </span>Task Description</h4>

<div id="A4.SS1.SSS1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS1.SSS1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Considering only the latest release versions of NPM packages, which packages are the top 8 most popular based on the Github star number, as well as their versions?</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS1.SSS2" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">D.1.2. </span>Database Schema</h4>

<div id="A4.SS1.SSS2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS1.SSS2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The task involves three tables from the <span id="A4.SS1.SSS2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">DEPS_DEV_V1</span> database:</p>
</div>
<section id="A4.SS1.SSS2.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Table: PROJECTS</h5>

<div id="A4.SS1.SSS2.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<ul id="A4.I1" class="ltx_itemize" style="--ltx-enum-leftmargin:2em;">
<li id="A4.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A4.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Name</span> (TEXT): Project identifier (e.g., ’steven-tey/dub’)</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A4.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A4.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.I1.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Type</span> (TEXT): Project type (e.g., ’GITHUB’, ’GITLAB’)</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A4.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A4.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.I1.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">StarsCount</span> (NUMBER): Number of stars for the project</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A4.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A4.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.I1.i4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">SnapshotAt</span> (NUMBER): Timestamp of data snapshot</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS1.SSS2.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Table: PACKAGEVERSIONS</h5>

<div id="A4.SS1.SSS2.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<ul id="A4.I2" class="ltx_itemize" style="--ltx-enum-leftmargin:2em;">
<li id="A4.I2.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A4.I2.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I2.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.I2.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Name</span> (TEXT): Package name (e.g., ’@dub/ui’)</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A4.I2.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A4.I2.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I2.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.I2.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Version</span> (TEXT): Version string (e.g., ’1.1.6’)</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A4.I2.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A4.I2.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I2.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.I2.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">System</span> (TEXT): Package system (e.g., ’NPM’, ’PYPI’)</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A4.I2.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A4.I2.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I2.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.I2.i4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">VersionInfo</span> (VARIANT): JSON containing <span id="A4.I2.i4.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">IsRelease</span> (boolean) and <span id="A4.I2.i4.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Ordinal</span> (number)</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A4.I2.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A4.I2.i5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I2.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.I2.i5.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">UpstreamPublishedAt</span> (NUMBER): Publication timestamp (often NULL)</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A4.I2.i6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A4.I2.i6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I2.i6.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.I2.i6.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">SnapshotAt</span> (NUMBER): Timestamp of data snapshot</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS1.SSS2.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Table: PACKAGEVERSIONTOPROJECT</h5>

<div id="A4.SS1.SSS2.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<ul id="A4.I3" class="ltx_itemize" style="--ltx-enum-leftmargin:2em;">
<li id="A4.I3.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A4.I3.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I3.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.I3.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">System</span> (TEXT): Package system</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A4.I3.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A4.I3.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I3.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.I3.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Name</span> (TEXT): Package name</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A4.I3.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A4.I3.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I3.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.I3.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Version</span> (TEXT): Package version</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A4.I3.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A4.I3.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I3.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.I3.i4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">ProjectType</span> (TEXT): Type of linked project (e.g., ’GITHUB’)</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A4.I3.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A4.I3.i5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I3.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.I3.i5.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">ProjectName</span> (TEXT): Name of linked project</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A4.I3.i6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A4.I3.i6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I3.i6.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.I3.i6.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">RelationType</span> (TEXT): Relationship type (e.g., ’SOURCE_REPO 
<br class="ltx_break">_TYPE’)</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS1.SSS3" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">D.1.3. </span>Direct SQL Generation Result &amp; Analysis</h4>

<div id="A4.SS1.SSS3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS1.SSS3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The baseline method directly assumed that <span id="A4.SS1.SSS3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">UpstreamPublishedAt</span> could be used to identify the latest release version of each NPM package.</p>
</div>
<section id="A4.SS1.SSS3.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Generated SQL strategy:</h5>

<div id="A4.SS1.SSS3.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<ul id="A4.I4" class="ltx_itemize" style="--ltx-enum-leftmargin:2em;">
<li id="A4.I4.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A4.I4.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I4.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Filter <span id="A4.I4.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">PACKAGEVERSIONS</span> for <span id="A4.I4.i1.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">System = ’NPM’</span> and <span id="A4.I4.i1.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">VersionInf 
<br class="ltx_break">o:IsRelease = TRUE</span></p>
</div></li>
<li id="A4.I4.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A4.I4.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I4.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Use <span id="A4.I4.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Name" ORDER BY "UpstreamPublishedAt" DESC)</span> to find latest release</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A4.I4.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A4.I4.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I4.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Filter <span id="A4.I4.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">WHERE "UpstreamPublishedAt" IS NOT NULL</span></p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div id="A4.SS1.SSS3.Px1.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS1.SSS3.Px1.p2.1" class="ltx_p">Critical error: The baseline SQL included the condition:</p>
<div id="A4.SS1.SSS3.Px1.p2.2" class="ltx_listing ltx_lstlisting ltx_framed ltx_framed_rectangle ltx_listing"><div class="ltx_listing_data"><a href="data:text/plain;base64,V0hFUkUgIlVwc3RyZWFtUHVibGlzaGVkQXQiIElTIE5PVCBOVUxM" download="">⬇</a></div>
<div id="lstnumberx1" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">WHERE</span><span id="lstnumberx1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">"</span><span id="lstnumberx1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">UpstreamPublishedAt</span><span id="lstnumberx1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">"</span><span id="lstnumberx1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">IS</span><span id="lstnumberx1.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx1.9" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">NOT</span><span id="lstnumberx1.10" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx1.11" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">NULL</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="A4.SS1.SSS3.Px1.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS1.SSS3.Px1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Why this failed: This assumption was made without verification. The baseline had no way to know whether <span id="A4.SS1.SSS3.Px1.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">UpstreamPublishedAt</span> was actually populated for NPM release versions. As it turns out, this field is NULL for the majority of NPM releases, causing the query to miss most packages and return incorrect results.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS1.SSS3.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Result</h5>

<div id="A4.SS1.SSS3.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS1.SSS3.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><em id="A4.SS1.SSS3.Px2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">Failed (Score: 0)</em></p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS1.SSS4" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">D.1.4. </span><span id="A4.SS1.SSS4.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">APEX-SQL</span> Result &amp; Analysis</h4>

<div id="A4.SS1.SSS4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS1.SSS4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.SS1.SSS4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span> 
<br class="ltx_break"><span id="A4.SS1.SSS4.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Exploration Round 1: Timestamp Availability Check</span></p>
</div>
<div id="A4.SS1.SSS4.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS1.SSS4.p2.1" class="ltx_p">Query 1: Check if UpstreamPublishedAt is populated for release versions</p>
<div id="A4.SS1.SSS4.p2.2" class="ltx_listing ltx_lstlisting ltx_framed ltx_framed_rectangle ltx_listing"><div class="ltx_listing_data"><a href="data:text/plain;base64,U0VMRUNUICJVcHN0cmVhbVB1Ymxpc2hlZEF0IiwgIlZlcnNpb25JbmZvIgpGUk9NICJQQUNLQUdFVkVSU0lPTlMiCldIRVJFICJTeXN0ZW0iID0gJ05QTScgQU5EICJWZXJzaW9uSW5mbyI6SXNSZWxlYXNlID0gdHJ1ZQpMSU1JVCAxMDs=" download="">⬇</a></div>
<div id="lstnumberx2" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">SELECT</span><span id="lstnumberx2.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx2.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">"</span><span id="lstnumberx2.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">UpstreamPublishedAt</span><span id="lstnumberx2.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">",</span><span id="lstnumberx2.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx2.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">"</span><span id="lstnumberx2.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">VersionInfo</span><span id="lstnumberx2.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">"</span>
</div>
<div id="lstnumberx3" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">FROM</span><span id="lstnumberx3.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx3.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">"</span><span id="lstnumberx3.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">PACKAGEVERSIONS</span><span id="lstnumberx3.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">"</span>
</div>
<div id="lstnumberx4" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">WHERE</span><span id="lstnumberx4.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx4.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">"</span><span id="lstnumberx4.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">System</span><span id="lstnumberx4.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">"</span><span id="lstnumberx4.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx4.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">=</span><span id="lstnumberx4.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx4.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">’</span><span id="lstnumberx4.10" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">NPM</span><span id="lstnumberx4.11" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">’</span><span id="lstnumberx4.12" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx4.13" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">AND</span><span id="lstnumberx4.14" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx4.15" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">"</span><span id="lstnumberx4.16" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">VersionInfo</span><span id="lstnumberx4.17" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">":</span><span id="lstnumberx4.18" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">IsRelease</span><span id="lstnumberx4.19" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx4.20" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">=</span><span id="lstnumberx4.21" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx4.22" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">true</span>
</div>
<div id="lstnumberx5" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">LIMIT</span><span id="lstnumberx5.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;"> </span><span id="lstnumberx5.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">10;</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="A4.SS1.SSS4.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS1.SSS4.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Result: All 10 samples showed <span id="A4.SS1.SSS4.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">UpstreamPublishedAt = None</span></p>
</div>
<div id="A4.SS1.SSS4.p4" class="ltx_para">

<div id="A4.SS1.SSS4.p9" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS1.SSS4.p9.1" class="ltx_p">Updated strategy:</p>
<ul id="A4.SS1.SSS4.p9.2" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="A4.I5.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"> 
<div id="A4.I5.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I5.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Evidence: <span id="A4.I5.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">UpstreamPublishedAt</span> is NULL for all NPM release versions, so cannot be used for timestamp. <span id="A4.I5.i1.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">VersionInfo</span> contains <span id="A4.I5.i1.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">IsRelease</span> boolean and <span id="A4.I5.i1.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Ordinal</span> number but no timestamp. 
<br class="ltx_break">Updated Plan: Use <span id="A4.I5.i1.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">VersionInfo:Ordinal</span> to find latest release per package via <span id="A4.I5.i1.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Name" ORDER BY "VersionInfo":Ordinal DESC)</span>.</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div>

<div id="A4.SS1.SSS4.p14" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS1.SSS4.p14.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A4.SS1.SSS4.p14.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Exploration Round 3: Verify Alternative Approach</span></p>

<section id="A4.SS1.SSS4.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Result</h5>

<div id="A4.SS1.SSS4.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS1.SSS4.Px1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><em id="A4.SS1.SSS4.Px1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">Success (Score: 1)</em></p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS1.SSS5" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">D.1.5. </span>Key Insights</h4>

<div id="A4.SS1.SSS5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS1.SSS5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Why exploration was essential:</p>
<ol id="A4.I6" class="ltx_enumerate" style="--ltx-enum-leftmargin:1.5em;">
<li id="A4.I6.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">(1)</span> 
<div id="A4.I6.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I6.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Data Quality Discovery: Exploration revealed that <span id="A4.I6.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">UpstreamPub 
<br class="ltx_break">lishedAt</span> is NULL for 43.7% of NPM releases—a critical data quality issue that the baseline could not detect.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A4.I6.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">(2)</span> 
<div id="A4.I6.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I6.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Alternative Strategy: After discovering the NULL issue, exploration identified <span id="A4.I6.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">VersionInfo:Ordinal</span> as a reliable alternative for version ordering.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A4.I6.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">(3)</span> 
<div id="A4.I6.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.I6.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Verification Before Commitment: The model verified the alternative approach before generating the final SQL, ensuring correctness.</p>
</div></li>
</ol>
</div>
<div id="A4.SS1.SSS5.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS1.SSS5.p2.1" class="ltx_p">This case demonstrates that exploration is not guessing—it’s systematic data quality verification that enables the model to adapt its strategy based on actual database characteristics.</p>
</div>
</section>

              d="M224 160C224 107 267 64 320 64C373 64 416 107 416 160L416 163.6C416 179.3 403.3 192 387.6 192L252.5 192C236.8 192 224.1 179.3 224.1 163.6L224.1 160zM569.6 172.8C580.2 186.9 577.3 207 563.2 217.6L465.4 290.9C470.7 299.8 474.7 309.6 477.2 320L576 320C593.7 320 608 334.3 608 352C608 369.7 593.7 384 576 384L480 384L480 416C480 418.6 479.9 421.3 479.8 423.9L563.2 486.4C577.3 497 580.2 517.1 569.6 531.2C559 545.3 538.9 548.2 524.8 537.6L461.7 490.3C438.5 534.5 395.2 566.5 344 574.2L344 344C344 330.7 333.3 320 320 320C306.7 320 296 330.7 296 344L296 574.2C244.8 566.5 201.5 534.5 178.3 490.3L115.2 537.6C101.1 548.2 81 545.3 70.4 531.2C59.8 517.1 62.7 497 76.8 486.4L160.2 423.9C160.1 421.3 160 418.7 160 416L160 384L64 384C46.3 384 32 369.7 32 352C32 334.3 46.3 320 64 320L162.8 320C165.3 309.6 169.3 299.8 174.6 290.9L76.8 217.6C62.7 207 59.8 186.9 70.4 172.8C81 158.7 101.1 155.8 115.2 166.4L224 248C236.3 242.9 249.8 240 264 240L376 240C390.2 240 403.7 242.8 416 248L524.8 166.4C538.9 155.8 559 158.7 569.6 172.8z" />
          </svg>)</span> button, located in the page header.</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong>Tip:</strong> You can select the relevant text first, to include it in your report.</p>
    <p>Our team has already identified <a class="ltx_ref" href="https://github.com/arXiv/html_feedback/issues"
        target="_blank">the following issues</a>. We appreciate your time reviewing and reporting rendering errors we
      may not have found yet. Your efforts will help us improve the HTML versions for all readers, because disability
      should not be a barrier to accessing research. Thank you for your continued support in championing open access for
      all.</p>
    <p>Have a free development cycle? Help support accessibility at arXiv! Our collaborators at LaTeXML maintain a <a
        class="ltx_ref" href="https://github.com/brucemiller/LaTeXML/wiki/Porting-LaTeX-packages-for-LaTeXML"
        target="_blank">list of packages that need conversion</a>, and welcome <a class="ltx_ref"
        href="https://github.com/brucemiller/LaTeXML/issues" target="_blank">developer contributions</a>.</p>
